title: Uniform bounds on compact sets from finite total masses and eventual ball bounds
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let ν_i (i ∈ ℕ) be measures on ℝ^P (= Euclid P) with ν_i(ℝ^P) < ∞ for every i. Assume that for every R > 0 there is B ∈ [0,∞] with B < ∞ such that ν_i(B̄_R(0)) ≤ B for all sufficiently large i (eventually along atTop). Then sup_i ν_i(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ν : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ i, ν i univ < ∞) → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∃ B : ℝ≥0∞, B < ∞ ∧ ∀ᶠ i in atTop, ν i (closedBall 0 R) ≤ B) → ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ⨆ i, ν i K < ∞
